tests.case: Steam provider popups remain isolated and normalized pagination captures only the two account pages

SteamHarvestScriptsTests.The_walk_asks_s.reason: Both native account surfaces follow the precise page-supplied offset URL in the same private Chromium session, whose fixture cookie remains available to every account load. The actual requests carry no-cache/no-store headers. The protocol fixture verifies the session cookie jar, not an on-wire Cookie header; no real Steam session or external network is used.
